transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I’ve been feeling really bad about myself lately. Like, I keep thinking I’ve ruined things for everybody, even when maybe it’s not that big of a deal.

I’m in an apprenticeship, and I keep feeling like I’m kind of a fake there… like I’m letting my family down, and even the younger apprentices. Stuff happens that other people would probably just fix and move on from, but I get stuck feeling like it’s my fault. I don’t know if that makes sense.
How long have you been feeling this way about yourself?

I think… maybe about nine months? It wasn’t all, like, dramatic the whole time, so I kind of kept telling myself it was fine. But it’s been there for a while, and it got harder to cover up once school and work started slipping a bit.
Have you been enjoying the things you used to like doing?

Um… not as much, I guess. I mean, I still tell myself I could do them, so it’s not like I hate them now or anything. But lately I’ll walk right past my sketchbook, or skip volleyball, and I don’t really feel much about it.

Even the volunteer group texts… I used to answer those pretty fast, because that stuff kind of made me feel like myself. Now I just sort of ignore them. That sounds bad, doesn’t it?
Do you still find pleasure in the activities you're doing, even if you're not doing them as often?

I mean… I can still do them, I guess, but it doesn’t really feel the same. Like I can walk past my sketchbook or skip volleyball and I don’t feel much of anything about it. Same with the volunteer group texts—I just leave them there, even though those used to be the things that made me feel like myself.

That’s probably not the best answer, sorry. It’s just… the pleasure part feels kind of muted, I think.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

Um… I don’t think so? Not a significant amount, at least. I haven’t really been tracking it super closely, but my clothes don’t feel dramatically different or anything. Should I have been keeping track?
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?
I don’t think so… not often, anyway. I mean, I get tense sometimes like anyone would, but I wouldn’t say I’m constantly nervous or on edge. Unless there’s a specific kind of thing you mean?
Are there any activities that you still enjoy and look forward to?

I’m trying to think of one… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but lately not really. I can walk past my sketchbook and just not care, or skip volleyball without feeling like I’m missing much. Even the volunteer group texts, I kind of just leave them sitting there.

Those used to be things I actually looked forward to, so… I guess no, not much right now. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you often feel guilty about things that you've done or haven't done?

Yeah… I mean, I try not to make it dramatic, because I know people make mistakes and you’re supposed to just fix them and move on. But that’s actually a lot of why I came in.

I keep feeling like I’ve ruined things for everybody, or like I’m kind of a fake in the apprenticeship. Like I’m letting my family down, and even the younger apprentices, over things that maybe other people wouldn’t take so hard. I don’t know if that counts as guilt exactly, but it’s been sitting on me a lot.
Has this feeling of being bad about yourself and the related thoughts been constant for the past nine months, or have there been periods where you felt better?

I guess there have been little moments where I could distract myself, but overall… it’s been going on for about nine months. I didn’t really want to call it that at first, because I was still showing up and trying to keep things normal.

It got harder to pretend once school and work started slipping, though. That’s when it felt like I couldn’t just explain it away anymore.
Have you had any periods in the last nine months where you felt completely back to normal?

Not completely, no. I mean, there were days where I could kind of get through things and seem fine, or maybe feel a little lighter for a bit, but I don’t think I’ve really felt back to normal in that whole stretch.

It’s been about nine months, I guess… and it got harder to keep acting like it was okay once school and work started slipping. Does that make sense?
Have you had more than one period in the last nine months where you felt really down, or has it been more of a continuous feeling?

It’s been more continuous, I think. Not like separate clear episodes where I got fully better in between.

I’ve had better days, or times I could keep busy and not think about it as much, but that down feeling has kind of been with me for about nine months. I guess it only became more obvious once school and work started slipping and I couldn’t hide it as well.
Is this low feeling something that you experience for most of the day, or is it more intermittent?

I’m not totally sure how to judge that, honestly. It’s not like I’m thinking about it every single second, especially if I’m busy or someone’s around.

But it does seem to be there in the background a lot of the day, if that makes sense. I can have stretches where I’m distracted and okay-ish, but when things get quiet it kind of comes back. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Has this low feeling you've been experiencing been going on for more than two years?

No, not more than two years. It’s been more like… about nine months, I think. It kind of stayed there, just low in the background, and then it got harder to cover it once school and work started slipping. Is that what you mean?
Has there been a two-week period where you felt this low for most of every day?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, but there definitely have been more than two weeks where it was there most of the day.

It’s kind of been going on in a low-level way for about nine months, and I was managing it better at first, I guess. It just became harder to hide once school and work started slipping.
Have you ever felt this low before the past nine months?

I don’t think so… not like this, at least. I mean, I’ve had normal bad weeks or stressful times before, but I can’t really remember feeling this low for this long before the last nine months. Does that answer it?
Has there been a two-week period where you felt this low for most of every day, nearly every day?

Yeah… I know I kind of said this already, but yes, I think there has been. It’s been sort of hanging around for about nine months overall, not always dramatic, but low most days. It got harder to act normal once school and work started slipping, if that makes sense.
Has there been any point in the last nine months where you felt like you were completely free of this low feeling for at least a couple of months?

No… I don’t think there’s been a couple months where it was totally gone. Maybe some better days or stretches where I could push it down more, but the low feeling has kind of been there in the background for about nine months. It just became harder to hide once school and work started slipping.
Has this low feeling you're experiencing been going on for more than a year?
No, not more than a year. It’s been about nine months, I think… maybe not awful every single day, but it’s been there, and it got harder to cover up once school and work started slipping.
Has there been any two-week period during the past nine months where you felt low for most of every day?

Yes… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but yeah, there’s definitely been more than two weeks where I felt low most of the day. It’s kind of been with me for about nine months, just in the background, and then it got harder to hide once school and work started slipping.
Has there been a two-week period where you felt low for most of every day, nearly every day?

Yes… yeah, there has. I think it’s fair to say it’s been most days for longer than two weeks. It’s been kind of hanging around for about nine months, even if I was trying not to make a big deal out of it. It just got harder to keep hidden once school and work started slipping.
